How do I use it properly the very first time?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Great question! Here's how to enjoy your first bourbon properly:
Start Simple:
Pour a small amount — about 1-2 fingers (1-2 oz) in a glass
Look at it — notice the color and clarity
Smell it first — bring the glass to your nose and take a gentle sniff (not too deep or it'll burn). You'll pick up vanilla, caramel, oak notes
Take a small sip — let it sit on your tongue for a moment before swallowing
Notice the finish — the warmth and flavors that linger after you swallow
Three Ways to Try It:
Neat (room temperature, nothing added) — This is the purest way, but can be strong for beginners
On the rocks (over ice) — Chills it and dilutes it slightly as the ice melts, making it smoother and easier to drink
With a splash of water — Just a teaspoon or two opens up the flavors and reduces the alcohol burn
My recommendation for your first time: Try it on the rocks. It's approachable, smooth, and lets you taste the bourbon without it being too intense. Once you get used to it, you can experiment with neat or adding water.
Don't rush it — sip slowly and see what flavors you notice. There's no wrong way as long as you enjoy it!
